title: Azure Virtual Desktop
cost: Windows 11 session host VM, disk, NAT and outbound IP. Eligible AVD user licensing must be established separately.
boundary: Creates the control plane and one Entra join prepared host. Registration is a separate explicit step with a fresh short lived host pool token and Microsoft agent installers. A VM template is not treated as host registration. Tenant SSO/MFA/client prerequisites, licensing and actual desktop login need live acceptance; FSLogix and profile storage are not included.
